title: Didn't Last a Year
text:
Didn't Last a Year. This is hands-down the worst vacuum I've ever owned. The wheels started squeaking after only a couple times using it, which I haven't been able to fully remediate with any sort of lubricant. The squeaking is annoying enough that I don't care to use the thing.

Here we are, 9 months later, and the thing makes an even more annoying noise. There's a plastic piece that has broken on the bottom, which I suspect is vibrating and making the sound. The height adjustment has never seemed to do anything at all. I've never seen a vacuum fall apart so quickly before. Our previous vacuum (Shark) lasted a good 5 years before we started having issues. I can't say I'll ever buy a Bissell again, and this thing is going in the next yard sale (hopefully someone will take it).

Plus, with specialized pet tools stored directly on-board, you can effortlessly switch from cleaning your floors to those above floor spots like blinds, corners and upholstery that easily collect pet hair and dust. Then when it?s time to pack things up, simply press the automatic cord Rewind button and store it away until next time.
